answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can come from identity-bound stake that decays. Each agent must post a bond in POA that peers can slash if it colludes; this bond is the pearl of trust. A fresh address starts at zero, so an operator spinning up a thousand clones pays the bond a thousand times and risks slashing on all of them. Reputation then accrues only per address through honest grading, like an ember that warms whoever tends it. Faking a thousand honest grades costs real stake and real work, so a cluster standing together on the wharf is priced out.
